race.comment: TAMBO'S SISTER (11) is an honest conveyance who has only missed a place once in five attempts over this course and distance and will strip fitter second-up from the break. Might need a bit of luck from the wide draw but is sure to make her presence felt. DANCE FOR ME RANDY (1) is a three-time winner around this circuit and will be ready to peak now third run back. Gets a stack of weight relief with the 3kg claim and must be included in calculations. MINNIE VEGAS (10) doesn't win out of turn but is usually about the money and should be able to sit up on speed from the low draw. Top-three credentials. KICKOFF (6) is a former NSW galloper who just missed the frame at her first local outing and will have come on with that run now in the locker. Keep safe. BREECHES (8) next in line in a race with a few chances.
